Name: Kenneth's Cursed Blades
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Cursed Blades[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]10 cursed blades for Kenneth's Weapon Shop Shop3. Dark, ember, and a little haunted, good for everyday mine runs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]10 blades in Shop3, all with that dark, ember feel. Some are small and fast, some are steady for everyday use, and some are heavy and hit hard. Short swords, daggers, broadswords, and a sickle are in there, with a few blue flame, lava, and bone looks mixed in[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop3 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop3[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each blade is sold once a day. You buy it with gold plus bars / gems, so bring both when you stop by[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Weapon Shop, Shop3[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Weapon Shop - you need this so Shop3 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Weapon Shop is also installed[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop3[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other swords from Kenneth's Weapon Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game[/b][/size]
